statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118653 affects Echo IP-based RateLimiter middleware, which accepts spoofed client-IP headers. Docker Agent v1.160.0 (commit f5cb1d66d67e274c2ec7cd22726614d5fffe98e8) does not call Proxy, ProxyWithConfig, RateLimiter or RateLimiterWithConfig. Inspection of the rebuilt binary Go function table finds Echo BodyLimitWithConfig, CORSWithConfig and RequestLogger functions, but no Proxy or RateLimiter functions; the vulnerable middleware is not linked into the Docker Agent executable. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-246p-cpwv-v3jq

GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree, which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release; see https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5932. The docker-engine APK ships dockerd built from Moby 29.7.2, which vendors github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto for OpenPGP and does not import golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp. go version -m on the published dockerd binary lists golang.org/x/crypto v0.55.0 as a module dependency but no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp import path, so the advisory OpenPGP code is not present in the shipped artifact.
Images shipping github.com/buger/jsonparser@1.1.2 already include the upstream fix for the Delete() malformed-input panic. The vulnerable 1.1.1 code is not present in the shipped artifact.
